newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech May CPI 0.1 pct mo/mo, 6.3 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech May CPI 0.1 pct mo/mo, 6.3 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech consumer prices rose 0.1 percent in May putting year-on-year inflation at 6.3 percent versus 6.7 percent in April, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
CZECH CONSUMER INFLATION May 97 April 97 May 96
MAY CPI BASKET COMPONENTS CHANGE MO/MO CHANGE YR/YR

Note. April basket component changes in brackets. All changes are rises except where stated. Prices have risen 25.1 percent from the average level for 1994 while the sliding average in May using a 1993 base was 8.0 percent. Basket of goods and services is unchanged from 1995.
The CSU said in a statement that core inflation in May accounted for +0.145 percent of total inflation, while the influence of price deregulation was +0.043 percent.
